thread:
emily_marketing: Heads-up 	6 Olivia (Forrester) just asked to push the embargo back by 2 hours so they can prep APAC notes. They also want a 20-min prebrief. Link to draft + fact-check: https://drive.google.com/example/press-draft-v2

 tom_s: Can we do that? Our planned social posts already slot at the original time. How late can we go w/o messing distribution?

 rachel_pr: Social can shift +/- 1 hour but channel partners are locked for the original window. If we delay 2 hours we need to update the agency and the partner ops flow. Not ideal but doable.

 lucas_product: Product ok to join prebrief. Quick question: the draft references "customer X" in the latency callout 	6 we must remove or anonymize. Which bit is that?

 emily_marketing: Good catch. The sentence: "Customer X observed 60% cost savings in production" should be removed. We'll replace with the anonymized benchmark line.

 emily_marketing: Olivia asked for a fact-check window of 48 hours and legal sign-off before they publish their analyst note. She also wants the embargo at 1:00 PM PT instead of 11:00 AM PT. That gives APAC folks time to comment.

 rachel_pr: If we move to 1:00 PM PT, we need to notify partners + update the release calendar. I'll coordinate. Can we provide a 30-min prebrief at 12:10 PM PT?

 olivia_analyst: (Olivia_analyst) Can confirm: 12:10 PT prebrief + 1:00 PT embargo works for my team. We need the fact-check doc by EOD tomorrow.

 emily_marketing: Noted. Lucas, can you paste the sanitized benchmark blurb here so I can update the fact-check file?

 lucas_product: Paste below:
```
Benchmark summary: internal web-chat v4; dataset = anonymized user prompts; median token unit cost reduced ~2.1x vs our v1 baseline. Tail p95 latency < 120ms on test harness. Measurements averaged over 3 runs.
```

 emma_legal: Legal: also add this sentence: "All benchmark results are internal; actual customer results may vary." Remove any named customer references. No commitments.

 tom_s: For quotes, PR wants three variations: (1) short soundbite, (2) metric-forward, (3) contextual for business press. Rachel, tagging you to draft.

 rachel_pr: I'll draft now and post in the doc. Want to keep metric language as "~2.1x median token cost reduction" per legal/product.

 emily_marketing: Press_bot, schedule embargo reminder for 12h and 1h before 1:00 PM PT on 2026-05-03 please. Also set a calendar update to partners once we finalize.

 press_bot: Reminder scheduled: 12h and 1h before 2026-05-03 13:00 PT. Calendar update task created for #marketing-ops.

 emily_marketing: Quick timeline check: fact-check doc to Olivia by 2026-05-01 17:00 PT, legal sign-off by 2026-05-02 12:00 PT, final sign-off 24h before embargo. Everyone react with :white_check_mark: when you've reviewed the fact-check entries in the doc.

 lucas_product: Done, updated the doc and removed the customer line. :white_check_mark:

 emily_marketing: Thanks. Rachel will drop quote drafts; Emma legal to check phrasing ASAP. I'll ping agency after we lock the embargo time.

 emily_marketing: Also: if partners cannot shift, fallback plan is to keep original distribution and offer Olivia an exclusive analyst briefing (no embargo change). Please flag any conflicts now"
